note: Class types. The schedule references these by id.

types.name: Barbell Strength
types.blurb: Squat, press, deadlift. Linear progression with a coach checking every rep. If you have never touched a barbell, start here.

types.name: Conditioning
types.blurb: Intervals, sleds, ropes and carries. Hard for forty-five minutes, then you go home. Scaled every session.

types.name: Mat & Mobility
types.blurb: Controlled work for hips, shoulders and the mid-back. The class that keeps the other two available to you.

types.name: Row & Ride
types.blurb: Rower and bike intervals with a screen you can ignore. Low impact, high effort, easy on the knees.
